g.text: 6. GPIO2/8/9 are strapping pins (GPIO8 = onboard LED): leave unconnected. GPIO10 is not a strap; R2 holds Q1 off during boot. GPIO20/21 (UART0) kept

g.desc: 6. GPIO2/8/9 are strapping pins (GPIO8 = onboard LED): leave unconnected. GPIO10 is not a strap; R2 holds Q1 off during boot. GPIO20/21 (UART0) kept

g.desc: 7. VBAT is tapped on the PCB side of the panel's own reverse-polarity diodes (IP-678A D1/D2); one common ground with the panel (CON1-16). F1 limits
